note: Local change on feat/blog-editor-status-picker-503. There is no assigned ticket number; THE-374 is the next free id after THE-373 so the digest can be appended without editing #531.json or THE-347.json. Rename this file if a real ticket id is assigned, and keep the digest.

entries.why: This change owns only callService's response parsing. The body is read as text and JSON.parse is tried; a non-JSON 503 says the server is not configured and nothing was saved, any other non-OK non-JSON body names the HTTP status, and an OK non-JSON body tells the admin to refresh. A JSON message string is still shown. Save, publish, and the confirm flow are unchanged.
